subject: Charged twice for November
body: I just noticed my card was charged $499 twice on Nov 3. Please refund the duplicate ASAP — this is over our team's budget cap.

subject: SAML login redirect loop
body: After SSO redirects from Okta we get bounced back to the login page. Started today around 9am PT. ~40 of our users are locked out.

subject: How do I export to CSV?
body: Hi! I can't find the export button on the dashboard. Is this a Pro feature?

subject: API returning 502s every few minutes
body: Our ingestion job is failing intermittently — looks like ~5% of requests are coming back as 502. Started ~30 minutes ago. Trace IDs attached.

subject: Can you add a Notion integration?
body: Would love a native Notion sync so we don't have to copy/paste. We'd pay for it.

subject: URGENT: customer data missing
body: Half our customer records disappeared from the workspace overnight. Last sync was successful at 11pm. We are getting calls from clients. Please escalate.

subject: Slow dashboard
body: Dashboard takes ~12s to load on the Reports tab. Was instant last week. Chrome on Mac.

subject: Forgot password link expired
body: I clicked the reset link from the email but it says expired. Sent it 3 minutes ago.

subject: Webhooks not delivering
body: We have a workflow webhook to https://hooks.example.com/inbound and none have fired since 2:14pm. Retry queue empty too.

subject: Pricing question
body: If we add 5 seats mid-cycle, do we pay prorated or wait until renewal?

subject: BUG: filter dropdown shows wrong options
body: On the Tickets page, the assignee filter shows users from a different workspace. Reproducing on staging too. Screenshot attached.

subject: Account locked after 'suspicious activity'
body: Got an email saying my account was locked. I haven't logged in from anywhere unusual. Need this resolved today, I have a demo at 4pm.

subject: Spam from your platform
body: Someone using your service is sending phishing emails impersonating our company. The 'from' is on your domain. Please shut them down.

subject: Dark mode request
body: Please add dark mode :)

subject: Webhook signature verification failing
body: We're computing HMAC SHA256 of the raw body with our signing secret and it never matches your X-Signature header. Worked fine last week. Did the algorithm change?

subject: Refund for cancelled subscription
body: I cancelled in October and was still charged for November. Order #INV-44219.

subject: Page crashes when I scroll fast
body: Whole tab freezes if I scroll the activity feed quickly. Chrome 130 / 32GB Mac.

subject: GDPR data export request
body: Per Article 15 of GDPR I'm requesting a full export of personal data associated with my account. Please advise the format and timeline.

subject: Looking forward to the new release
body: Just wanted to say the team is excited about v3. Keep up the great work!

subject: Production outage: all writes failing
body: Every POST to /v1/items is returning 503 since 14:02 UTC. We have customer-facing impact. Status page shows green. This is a Sev1 for us.
